name: FMN riboswitch with crystallographic Mg bridge
source: RCSB PDB 3F4E; FMN riboswitch bound to flavin mononucleotide with crystallographic Mg ion X:304 retained near the FMN phosphate.
notes: Metal-coordination companion to 1fmn-fmn-riboswitch. The receptor keeps Mg X:304 from 3F4E, which lies 2.54 A from FMN O1P in the crystal structure and exercises MacVina's metalCoordination calibration term.
